# The Pyramid
[italic]This page has been rewritten more often than any other in the book. Every version was true when it was written.[/italic]
[italic]Bridge recording, hauler, name withheld.[/italic]
"It's not on the scope. It's on the scope. It's been on the scope the whole time, why didn't anyone—"
[bold]"Captain! Look at the wall!"[/bold]
"What— what about the damn wall?!"
[color=#e8482a][bold]"Oh god— WHAT IS THAT—"[/bold][/color]
[color=#808080][italic]The recording suddenly cuts.[/italic][/color]
Ask anyone who has met it what it is, and they won't know. Ask them what it was like, and they all say the same thing, in the same words:
[color=#9fd3ff][bolditalic]It should not be there.[/bolditalic][/color]
## What has been seen
[italic]Salvage crew debrief. Three accounts, taken separately.[/italic]
"It was bigger than the station."
"It was small. I could have covered it with my thumb."
"It wasn't any size. [bold]Stop asking me that.[/bold]"
[italic]Maintenance log, a line in the margin.[/italic]
"Sound only comes in waves near it. Between them I couldn't hear my own hands. Fixed the gyro in one of the quiet parts. [italic]Don't remember fixing it.[/italic]"
[italic]Interview, deck hand, after a hauler came back with its paint stripped bare.[/italic]
"It looked at us. [italic]I don't know what with.[/italic]"
[italic]Cargo manifest, amended by hand.[/italic]
"One flake, chrome, taken off the outer hull. Heavier than it looks. Still warm after six hours. [bold]Something has been following us since we brought it aboard.[/bold]"
[color=#808080][italic]No reply is on file.[/italic][/color]
## Where it comes from
There is a rumour, passed between salvage crews who work deep within [textlink="the Coda" link="WGLoreUnmooring"], and never confirmed: a Moon orbiting a fractured planet, [italic]its surface wilting away like petals on a rose.[/italic]
It is said that [textlink="the Choir" link="WGLoreChoir"] goes [bold]quiet[/bold] around the Moon.
[italic]Recovered log, survey tender, date unreadable.[/italic]
"We'd been shadowing one of their ships for two days. Robes on the bridge, a stone on the deck, the usual. Then it turned round and burned for the anchors faster than I've seen anything move out there."
"Did you follow it?"
"No. We went on, to see what they'd turned away from. I don't know how we made it out."
"What did you see?"
"I don't know. [color=#e8482a][bold]It screamed.[/bold][/color] We tried to turn, but it tore our ship in half. That's all I can remember."
## If it finds you
Stay out of its marks. Don't let it keep you. It has left ships alone before, once it was [italic]done[/italic] with them.
[color=#e8482a][bold]There are always bodies after it's done.[/bold][/color]
